description:
A real samples register and showroom stocking domain, replacing three demo screens that persist nothing.

Epic: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/epics.md (Epic 4)
Architecture: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/architecture.md
Requires: W1 merged; W3 merged (supplier FK)
Blocks: nothing

userStories.title: Migration: showrooms and samples
userStories.description: As the office, I want a physical sample register, so that we know where every sample is.
acceptanceCriteria: samples.barcode is unique; colourway_id is RESTRICT and nullable; supplier_id and showroom_id are SET NULL
status is CHECK-constrained to in_library, out, missing, retired
A test asserts no legacy_* table gained a column
A test asserts samples are not inventory: no code path reads or writes qty_available or qty_reserved
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Migration: sample_loans with the one-open-loan index
userStories.description: As the office, I want loan history to be append-only and unambiguous.
acceptanceCriteria: A partial unique index on sample_id WHERE returned_at IS NULL enforces at most one open loan
holder_name is a snapshot, so history survives a trade account being unlinked or renamed
sample_loans.sample_id is RESTRICT — history is a record, not an owned child
A test proves two concurrent check-outs yield one loan and one 409
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Migration: sample_orders
userStories.description: As a showroom, I want to order sample material and track it.
acceptanceCriteria: status is CHECK-constrained through requested, ordered, in_transit, received, displayed, cancelled
Each transition has its own timestamp column
showroom_id is RESTRICT; colourway_id is RESTRICT; supplier_id is SET NULL
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Sample read models, filters and overdue derivation
userStories.description: As the office, I want to see which samples are out and which are overdue.
acceptanceCriteria: Overdue is DERIVED at read time, never stored
Filters: q, status, showroom_id, supplier_id, overdue, include_archived; paginated
Each row embeds its open loan and a loan count
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Sample CRUD routes and by-barcode lookup
userStories.description: As a scanner, I want one deterministic answer for a barcode.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /admin/samples/by-barcode/:barcode returns 200 or 404, never a filtered list
POST returns 409 on a duplicate barcode, detected by the database
DELETE is blocked by sample_loans
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Check-out and check-in verb routes
userStories.description: As showroom staff, I want to send a sample out and take it back in.
acceptanceCriteria: Both are verb routes, not a status PATCH — each writes two tables in one transaction
withSampleTxn mirrors withOrderTxn: BEGIN, SELECT FOR UPDATE, run, COMMIT, re-read
Already out returns 409 from a caught 23505 on the partial index, never a pre-check
Check-in of a sample that is not out returns 409
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Sample-order lifecycle module and routes
userStories.description: As a showroom, I want to advance an order through its states.
acceptanceCriteria: ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS and requireStatus live in a module the CRM mirrors
An invalid transition returns 409
DELETE is refused unless the order is requested or cancelled
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: AdminSamples and AdminShowrooms screens
userStories.description: As the office, I want to manage the register in the CRM.
acceptanceCriteria: Both use the W1 kit
Overdue is shown from the API value, not recomputed in the browser
legacy_cuttings.comments is never displayed — it holds third parties personal data
Gates green: `( cd atelier-crm && npm test && npm run build )`
userStories.notes: Needed the showroom API no story creates (routes, module, registry entry) — all in-bounds files | done 2026-08-06T07:45:45Z

userStories.title: AdminSampleOrders, live scanner, retired-route redirects
userStories.description: As showroom staff, I want the scanner to actually record a movement.
acceptanceCriteria: SampleScanner calls by-barcode then check-out or check-in
sampleFlow.js mirrors the API transitions so the UI never offers one that 409s
/samples and /showroom-samples redirect to the live screens rather than falling into the catch-all
Gates green: `( cd atelier-crm && npm test && npm run build )`
